mission_check.capability: Retain multiple model-selected natural-battle choices and settled outcomes under one train root
mission_check.learned_authority: Frozen ranker owns attacks inside the episode; no fit, teacher fallback, collection-player promotion, or increased authority
mission_check.transfer_test: Future source-disjoint development episodes across party and opponent contexts; none attempted here
mission_check.cheapest_falsifier: ROM-free tests of choice/outcome persistence, root and partition inheritance, semantic de-duplication, and stopping before another encounter on missing trace or budget overrun
mission_check.time_box: One implementation session, at most two hours
mission_check.stop_condition: No consumed-root replay, fit, development opening, full run, or publication; no pilot before an authenticated source-specific bounded launcher exists

next_bounded_objective: Select one untouched train source prospectively, build a source-authenticated launcher with a hard action/frame limiter and natural-encounter-only setup, then run at most one mechanical pilot. Stop if its choice/outcome trace is missing or contexts do not yield useful varied decisions; do not fit on this pilot alone.
